found.title: Visitor key is taken from the request body, violating AC-6.3. Clients can set any key, bypass the 24h dedup by sending a new key each time, and inflate view counts. The key must be derived server-side as sha256(ip + user-agent) or sha256(X-Visitor-ID).
referrerSource is read from the request body, violating AC-6.4. It must be classified on the server from the Referer header. Any client can spoof the source value.
Unpublished posts return 400 (BLOG_NOT_PUBLISHED), violating AC-6.8, which requires 404 for unpublished or unknown posts.
A malformed blogId (e.g. /api/blog/abc/view) makes Blog.findById throw a Mongoose CastError, which returns 500 instead of the 404 required for unknown posts. Validate the ObjectId before querying.
A duplicate view within 24h returns a 400 error (VIEW_ALREADY_RECORDED), violating AC-6.5. Deduplication must respond 200 and never surface as an error to the client.

The dedup check (findOne) and the insert (create) are not atomic. Concurrent requests from the same visitor can both pass the check and create duplicate views. Use a unique index on (blog, visitorKey, day bucket) or an atomic upsert.
The raw Authorization header is logged to console, violating AC-10.2. Any JWT sent by an admin or author ends up in the logs, where it can be read or used to impersonate them.
Only role 'admin' is checked, violating AC-6.6, which also requires 'author' tokens to set isAdminView: true. Author views are counted in public statistics, inflating the totals.

found.title: Comment excerpt rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML: stored XSS. A comment containing executes script for every admin who views the table. AC-4.3 requires plain text, never HTML.
Excerpt is truncated to 50 characters, but AC-4.3 requires at most 120 characters.

setInterval(refetch, 30000) polls every 30 seconds with no clearInterval cleanup. This violates AC-10.5 (no background polling), and each effect re-run or unmount leaks another timer that keeps hitting the API.
useAnalyticsKpis dependencies omit category. Changing the category filter does not re-fetch the KPI cards, violating AC-5.3.
Avg Engagement is formatted with a trailing '%', but AC-2.4 defines it as average comments per published post, a count rather than a percentage. A value of 2.5 displays as '2.5%'.
Signing secret and SEGMENT_WRITE_KEY hardcoded and committed; violates AC-10.1 (config from .env only). The PR's 'test fixture' note does not change this.
exportCsv issues BlogView.countDocuments and Comment.countDocuments per post in a loop (N+1). Query count grows with post count, violating AC-10.4 (bounded aggregations).
escapeCSV does not prefix cells starting with =, +, -, or @ with a single quote, so a post title like =HYPERLINK(...) is evaluated as a formula in spreadsheet apps. Violates AC-5.6.
escapeCSV quotes only on ',', '"' and '\n'; a bare '\r' in a title is not quoted and can break CSV row structure.
Client imports EXPORT_SIGNING_SECRET from server/src/configs; violates AC-10.1 (client never imports from server/) and ships the secret in the client bundle.
Signature check is a no-op: the secret is a non-empty constant, so '!EXPORT_SIGNING_SECRET' is always false and the file is never verified.
